title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks (reference implementation)
description: Research package of CROSS-MORSE (post-training transport control for frozen graph neural networks on seven benchmarks): implementation with a sealed eight-stage lifecycle, dataset adapters, Slurm launchers with the Arrhenius site profile, environment specifications, seven complete synthetic example runs, the run-archive contract (pack, verify, deposit, ingest) and the scripts that build the manuscript's run-derived tables and figures from completed run directories. Companion to the manuscript submitted to Scientific Reports.
